name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram skill (43 types: architecture, flowchart, sequence, layer stack, morphological box, evidence chain, …) as self-contained HTML + inline SVG, plus /export-diagram (svg/png) and /import-drawio (redraw draw.io). Vendored from the private skill repo phanlemanh/skill (upstream cathrynlavery/diagram-design, MIT) with local patches listed in skills/diagram-design/LOCAL-PATCHES.md — see NOTICE for the pinned commit and tree-hash. Skin state lives in the CONSUMING REPO (docs/reference/diagram-skin.md, closed schema DIAGRAM-SKIN-TEMPLATE), never inside this package, so one install serves every repo and every teammate. Version follows the skill's metadata.version and bumps only when the vendored tree-hash changes. Companion to acceptance-gate's human-facing-language law (N5 + DECISION-DIAGRAM-SURFACES) and the DIAGRAM-RULE presentation law; installable on its own.
